opportunities.title: 2D/3D Machine CAD and Demo
opportunities.description: I will share a short video of a mechanical machine and back it up with dimensions, multi-angle photos, and a rough sketch I already have. From that reference material I need you to: • Draft accurate 2D manufacturing drawings. • Build a full 3D CAD model ready for editing. • Produce an animation that first shows the step-by-step assembly (exploded view is fine) and then demonstrates the machine’s complete range of motion in action. The animation should be clear enough that a technician could follow the sequence, yet engaging enough for a client presentation. SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360, or a comparable parametric package is perfectly acceptable—use whichever you are fastest with as long as the native file, a neutral format (STEP/IGES), and an MP4/AVI render are delivered. I’ll be on hand to answer dimension questions or supply extra photos as you refine the model. Once I confirm the drawings match the real-world measurements and the motion video runs smoothly without collisions, the project is complete.

opportunities.title: Urgent: Smart, Organised Generalist VA needed (Marketing, Figma Design, Automation, Vibe Coding)
opportunities.description: Highly versatile assistant needed for supporting multiple projects being setup, tested and launched as part of a new venture studio. Your primary focus will be marketing and automation tasks. You'll need to be: 1. Highly organised - you do highly detailed spreadsheets and can run deep analysis work. 2. Design - you are able to use design tools like Figma, Adobe Illustrator etc. Canva is NOT a proper design tool. 3. Marketing tasks - you can undertake SEO/AEO, article writing and social media design and posting tasks 4. Automation - you can assist with setting up marketing automations across social, content so have some familiarity with python 5. Recruitment - you can assist with hiring and recruitment based tasks 6. Basic bookkeeping - you can perform basic bookkeeping tasks in QBO You must have fluent written and spoken English. To be shortlisted please note: 1. We are not using agencies - also 'autobidders' who do not read this job description will be removed. 2. The hourly rate you bid, is the one we accept 3. You will be required for a minimum of 15 hours (2-3 days per week) for a minimum 6 months 4. AI is there to assist you, not do the work for you. If you don't have skills, do not rely on AI to do the work for you. You will need review all your work and be able to edit it without AI. While we expect you to use AI, you must understand the tasks you are undertaking without it. 5. You must have access to Claude Pro and SEMrush yourself. We cannot create multiple accounts under their policies. Free AI or marketing tools are unacceptable. 6. You must rate your skills for each of the requirements above (1 - poor knowledge/skill/confidence to 10 - excellent knowledge/skill/confidence). Please ensure you provide the rating to each of the 6 items above in your application. The hiring process is as follows: 1. You will be notified that you have been shortlisted. 2. You will need to attend a video interview 3. You will be provided with a 6-month contract and an offer of contract work 4. The work will include a two-week paid trial I look forward to working with a professional who has a proper office setup, is well versed in starting and growing new startup projects and is curious and actively advancing their skills in one or more of the above areas. NOTE: The first few weeks of your engagement, you'll be doing tasks manually. Creating and posting blogs, social media, backlink building etc. After that, you'll be expected to automate tasks using python/cron based semi and fully autonomous workflows. You'll be given multiple projects to do this for, along with guidance and support from a team member. Thank you.

opportunities.title: UiPath Web Report Automation
opportunities.description: I need a UiPath workflow that signs in to our browser-based reporting site with a simple username/password, retrieves different reports, distills each one to the key metrics we track, and writes those figures into the existing cloud Excel workbooks that power our live dashboard. The robot must loop every five minutes, so solid scheduling through Orchestrator (or an equivalent trigger) and reliable exception handling are essential. Please build the solution in UiPath Studio, using standard browser automation (no client-side extensions that would block frequent runs) and the Office 365 / Excel Online activities for writing data. Each run should end with a short log entry confirming success or flagging any issues so we can intervene quickly. Deliverables: • Fully documented UiPath project (.xaml files, config) • Credentials vault or secure string approach for the website login • Orchestrator (or Windows Task) schedule set to a 5-minute interval • Step-by-step guide for deployment and future maintenance I’ll provide sample credentials, the report URLs, and a template of the cloud workbooks once we agree. Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any clarifying questions.

opportunities.title: Custom Classic E-commerce Site Build
opportunities.description: I need a complete, from-scratch e-commerce website that will showcase and sell physical products. The overall aesthetic should feel classic and timeless—clean lines, balanced typography, and a refined color palette that projects trust and heritage rather than a trendy, minimalist look. If you have a preferred stack or platform that will meet these needs elegantly, outline why it’s the best fit and any licensing implications. Quality, a polished classic design, seamless functionality without broken links, and smooth user experience are my top priorities. Let’s talk timeline, milestones, and anything else you need to get started.

opportunities.title: Design a Premium Korean-Inspired Perfume Website – HTML Template with Inquiry Management
opportunities.description: Project Description I am looking for a creative and experienced web designer to design a premium, Korean-inspired, single-page website template for a luxury perfume collection. The website should reflect Korean aesthetics, elegance, sophistication, and modern luxury while maintaining a clean, professional, and visually appealing appearance. The primary objective is to showcase five perfume products through an attractive product listing page and allow interested customers to submit inquiries through a popup form. All inquiries should be stored in a database and accessible through a secure login-protected admin panel. Key Requirements 1. Korean-Inspired Design Theme Create a sophisticated design inspired by Korean culture, aesthetics, and modern luxury. Use a professional, elegant, and minimal colour palette, preferably beige, ivory, champagne, and other subtle neutral shades. Incorporate Korean-inspired visual elements, typography, and decorative details without making the design look overcrowded. Maintain a premium, high-end perfume brand aesthetic. 2. Header and Navigation Menu Design an elegant header with space for the brand logo. Include a top navigation menu with relevant sections such as Home, Collection, About Us, and Contact. Ensure smooth navigation between sections. 3. Hero Banner with additional 3 more banner(You have to design) image should have no copy right Create an attractive, full-width hero banner that reflects Korean-inspired luxury perfumery. Use high-quality visuals, elegant typography, and a compelling headline. Include a suitable call-to-action button to encourage visitors to explore the perfume collection. 4. Product Listing – Five Perfumes Display five perfume products in an attractive, well-organised layout. Each product should include: Product image Product name Short description Relevant fragrance details A View Details button A Buy Now / Enquire Now button Clicking the View Details button should open a popup or modal containing detailed product information, including fragrance notes, product descriptions, and other relevant details. 5. Customer Inquiry Form When a visitor clicks the Buy Now / Enquire Now button, an inquiry form should open in a popup. The form should capture relevant customer details, such as: Full Name Mobile Number Email Address Product of Interest Quantity or other relevant requirements Additional Message (optional) Include appropriate form validation and a success message after submission. Store all submitted inquiries securely in a database. Associate each inquiry with the relevant perfume product. 6. Admin Login and Inquiry Management Develop a secure login screen for the administrator. After successful login, the administrator should be able to access a dashboard to view submitted inquiries. Display inquiry information in a structured table, including customer details, selected product, submission date, and inquiry message. Provide basic functionality to view inquiry details and manage inquiry status, if feasible. Protect the admin area from unauthorised access. 7. Footer Design a visually appealing footer consistent with the Korean-inspired luxury theme. Include relevant links, contact information, social media links, and copyright information. Maintain consistency with the overall website design. Technical Expectations Responsive design compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 8. Korean Language Support and Korean Banner Content The website must support both English and Korean languages. Include a language-switching option (English / 한국어) in the top navigation menu. All relevant website content, including product names, descriptions, navigation menus, buttons, inquiry forms, and other interface elements, should be available in both languages. The hero banner should feature selected Korean-language text to reinforce the Korean-inspired luxury perfume concept. Use elegant Korean typography that complements the premium design. Ensure Korean characters render correctly across desktop and mobile devices. The website layout must adapt properly to Korean text, including differences in text length, spacing, and typography. The five perfume products should support Korean names and descriptions wherever applicable. The inquiry form and admin dashboard should handle Korean characters correctly and store them in the database without encoding issues. Design Direction: The website should combine a sophisticated Korean aesthetic with a modern luxury perfume presentation. Korean text on the banner should feel natural and elegant rather than decorative or overcrowded. Important: Please ensure the website uses proper UTF-8 encoding and a database configuration that supports Korean characters. The freelancer is also welcome to suggest suitable Korean phrases for the hero banner that communicate elegance, fragrance, and luxury. Clean, well-structured, and maintainable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Smooth animations and transitions where appropriate. Optimised images and fast page loading. Database for storing customer inquiries. Secure authentication for the admin panel. Cross-browser compatibility. With device responsive Note: Although the primary requirement is a single-page website, the admin login and inquiry dashboard may be implemented as separate pages or routes, depending on the proposed technical approach. Creative Freedom I welcome designers who can bring fresh ideas and suggest additional features that enhance the website's visual appeal, usability, and overall luxury experience. You are encouraged to propose creative layouts, elegant animations, premium product presentation styles, and other design improvements that align with the Korean-inspired perfume concept. Expected Deliverables Complete website design and responsive HTML template. Five-product listing section with individual product detail popups. Functional customer inquiry form. Database integration for inquiry storage. Admin login and inquiry management dashboard. Complete source code and setup instructions. Basic testing to ensure all functionalities work correctly. When Submitting Your Proposal Please share: Your portfolio or examples of similar projects. Your proposed technology stack. Your estimated project completion time. Your quotation for the complete project. Any additional design or functionality suggestions. My priority is to achieve a sophisticated, premium-looking website that combines Korean-inspired aesthetics with a smooth customer inquiry experience. I am open to creative suggestions from the selected freelancer to make the final result more attractive and professional.

opportunities.title: Nonlinear FEA Test for PP Panel
opportunities.description: Project Title: Nonlinear FEA of an Injection-Molded PP Ground Panel Under Plate Load (Stage 1 – Test) About the project We manufacture modular injection-molded plastic ground panels, used to build temporary roads for trucks, cranes and heavy equipment. We’re planning a full FEA study for our technical documentation. This first stage is a paid test on a single panel with one loading setup. If the quality is right, more stages will follow: other load cases, multi-panel assemblies with interlocking joints, and calibration against physical tests. What we provide 3D model of the panel (STEP), one piece, solid geometry with ribs Material datasheet: Borouge BD265MO, heterophasic PP block copolymer for injection molding Tensile modulus: 1200 MPa (ISO 527-2) Flexural modulus: 1250 MPa (ISO 178) Tensile stress at yield: 22 MPa at 6% strain Density: 900–910 kg/m³ Notched Charpy/Izod at 23 °C: No Break Scope: Stage 1 One panel, fully supported on the ground, loaded by a rigid square plate of 152.4 × 152.4 mm, in two load positions: Case A: plate centered over a rib Case B: plate centered between ribs Load is increased incrementally up to 200 kN, or until displacement reaches 10% of the panel thickness or excessive plastic strain occurs, whichever comes first. Modeling requirements Material: nonlinear elastic-plastic model (at least bilinear) built from the datasheet: yield at 22 MPa / 6% strain, with a reasonable post-yield tangent modulus. Poisson’s ratio 0.40 unless you justify another value. Support: panel resting on a rigid flat floor (like concrete), modeled with contact, not fixed supports. Panel–floor friction μ ≈ 0.3, or justify your choice. Loading plate: rigid steel body in contact with the panel (frictionless or μ ≈ 0.2). Analysis: static, nonlinear (material + contact + large deformation where relevant), quasi-static loading at 23 °C, no creep. Mesh: good quality solid mesh, refined under the plate and at the rib tops and fillets. Include a mesh convergence check, at least two mesh densities compared on peak displacement and stress. Use symmetry if applicable, and state it clearly. Every assumption must be documented. Deliverables (for each case, A and B) High-resolution color maps (PNG, at least 1920 px wide): Von Mises stress Equivalent plastic strain Total deformation At least one section cut through the loaded rib zone Load vs. displacement curve (plate displacement), as a chart plus raw data in CSV/Excel Load at first yield, and load at the stop criterion (10% thickness or plastic-strain limit) Screenshot of the mesh in the software (global view and close-up under the plate), with element type, size and count Critical points of the geometry marked on the images Short technical report (PDF, in Portuguese preferred, English acceptable): assumptions, material curve, mesh, boundary conditions, results, and a brief interpretation Editable simulation files (ANSYS Workbench preferred, .wbpz archive, or Abaqus .cae/.inp), with the software version stated Requirements Proven experience with nonlinear FEA of plastic parts (ANSYS, Abaqus or similar) Solid understanding of contact modeling and convergence in nonlinear analysis A commercial or academic research license with no node limit that would affect results (student versions with node limits are not acceptable) Ability to explain results in plain language for a technical catalog NDA required: the geometry is confidential and must not be shared or reused Timeline: 2–3 days after receiving files Revisions: 1 round included (minor adjustments to setup or outputs) To apply, please include: Software and version you’ll use One or two examples of nonlinear plastic or contact FEA you’ve done. Images with sensitive details hidden are fine. Your proposed post-yield material approach, in one or two lines Price and delivery time Proposals without answers to these questions won’t be considered.

opportunities.title: Preparar artículo Wikipedia inglés
opportunities.description: Debes tener cuenta en Wikipedia inglés con artículos ya publicados. Cuento con un artículo redactado en inglés fuera de la plataforma y necesito corregir y darle formato para que cumpla los estándares de Wikipedia. El trabajo se centra en corregir y dar formato, con especial atención a la estructura, las secciones, las tablas y el infobox. El texto ya está completo; lo que requiero es convertirlo en wikitext listo para publicarse siguiendo el Manual of Style de la Wikipedia en inglés (MOS). Entrego el borrador en Word/Google Docs y espero recibir: • Versión en wikitexto con la jerarquía correcta de secciones, encabezados y enlaces internos. • Tablas y plantillas convertidas a sintaxis Wiki, bien alineadas y accesibles. • Infobox adecuado (con la plantilla pertinente) rellenado correctamente. • Notas sobre cualquier ajuste necesario para evitar problemas de neutralidad o verificabilidad. • Breve guía de pasos finales para subirlo al espacio principal, incluidos resúmenes de edición recomendados. Se valorará experiencia previa editando en enwiki, conocimiento de herramientas como VisualEditor, Wikicode y referencias a políticas clave (NPOV, Verifiability). Busco un resultado limpio, coherente y listo para revisión comunitaria sin tropiezos técnicos.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "Debes tener cuenta en Wikipedia inglés con artículos ya publicados. Cuento con un artículo redactado en inglés fuera de la plataforma y necesito corregir y darle formato para que cumpla los estándares de Wikipedia. El trabajo se centra en corregir y dar formato, con especial atención a la estructura, las secciones, las tablas y el infobox. El texto ya está completo; lo que requiero es convertirlo en wikitext listo para publicarse siguiendo el Manual of Style de la Wikipedia en inglés (MOS). Entrego el borrador en Word/Google Docs y espero recibir: • Versión en wikitexto con la jerarquía correcta de secciones, encabezados y enlaces internos. • Tablas y plantillas convertidas a sintaxis Wiki, bien alineadas y accesibles. • Infobox adecuado (con la plantilla pertinente) rellenado correctamente. • Notas sobre cualquier ajuste necesario para evitar problemas de neutralidad o verificabilidad. • Breve guía de pasos finales para subirlo al espacio principal, incluidos resúmenes de edición recomendados. Se valorará experiencia previa editando en enwiki, conocimiento de herramientas como VisualEditor, Wikicode y referencias a políticas clave (NPOV, Verifiability). Busco un resultado limpio, coherente y listo para revisión comunitaria sin tropiezos técnicos."

opportunities.title: Etsy Photo Editing & Re-Angling
opportunities.description: I have a small batch of product shots that need to be transformed into polished, shop-ready images for my Etsy listings. Each photo should end up on a lifestyle background that genuinely complements the item, not a stark studio white. Beyond the backdrop swap, I’d like several distinct angle variations for every product so shoppers can see the piece from multiple realistic perspectives. Here’s how I see the work flowing: • For every source image, deliver one primary lifestyle version plus at least two additional angles that still feel true to the original object’s proportions and lighting. • Edits must look seamless—no jagged cut-outs, color casts, or warped edges. • Files should return at the same or higher resolution, saved both as high-quality JPGs and layered PSDs so I can tweak text or sizing later if needed. When you reply, include: • Before-and-after examples that show a comparable background swap and angle shift. • A brief, detailed proposal describing the steps you’ll take to adjust perspective while maintaining realism (e.g., camera-raw corrections, Photoshop warp, 3D mock-ups, or other techniques). • Any relevant experience with ecommerce imagery—especially Etsy or Amazon—and the software you’ll rely on (Photoshop, Lightroom, Topaz, etc.). I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit and will supply the initial files immediately. Looking forward to seeing your approach.

opportunities.title: WEBSITE REDESIGN, GOOGLE RANKING & SEO/AEO/GEO SPECIALIST NEEDED FOR AIM STUDIO
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced web designer/developer and search optimization specialist to improve our existing website: https://aimstudio.co.in/ AIM Studio is an AI technology brand offering AI products, automation solutions, intelligent tools, and software platforms. Our goal is to build a premium, professional website that delivers an excellent user experience, performs well technically, and achieves stronger visibility on Google Search and AI-powered discovery platforms. This project involves improving the existing website. A complete rebuild is not required unless justified by a technical assessment. Budget: Under ₹50,000 INR. Please submit your best competitive bid within this budget. Scope of Work 1. UI/UX Design and Development - Modernize the website with a premium, professional SaaS-style design. - Improve layout, typography, navigation, visual hierarchy, and product presentation. - Improve calls to action and conversion paths. - Ensure responsive behavior across mobile, tablet, and desktop. - Maintain brand consistency and improve user engagement. 2. Technical SEO and Google Search Ranking - Conduct a comprehensive technical SEO audit. - Identify opportunities to improve Google Search rankings for relevant keywords. - Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-intent mapping. - Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, URLs, and internal linking. - Improve crawlability, indexability, XML sitemap, robots.txt, and canonical tags. - Implement appropriate structured data and schema markup. - Optimize Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability. - Review Google Search Console and analytics data where access is available. - Develop a practical strategy to improve organic traffic and search visibility. 3. AEO — Answer Engine Optimization - Structure content to answer relevant user questions clearly. - Improve FAQs and question-based content where appropriate. - Make product and service information easier for search engines and AI answer systems to interpret. - Maintain accurate, consistent, and well-structured information. 4. GEO — Generative Engine Optimization - Improve discoverability across AI-powered search and answer platforms. - Strengthen brand and product descriptions, entity consistency, and supporting evidence. - Improve content structure for potential inclusion in AI-generated answers. - Recommend strategies to build topical authority and credible external references. 5. Performance and Technical Quality - Review the existing technology stack and architecture. - Improve loading speed, accessibility, reliability, and maintainability. - Preserve existing functionality and URLs wherever possible. - Test across major browsers and device sizes. - Provide documentation of completed changes. Portfolio Requirements Applicants must provide: - Links to at least 2–3 live websites they personally designed, developed, or significantly improved. - Relevant experience with AI, SaaS, technology, or product-focused websites. - A brief explanation of their contribution to each project. - Examples of websites where they improved Google rankings or organic search traffic, preferably with verifiable before-and-after data. - Relevant case studies, performance reports, or client references, if available. Please distinguish between your own work and projects shared only as design inspiration. Expected Deliverables - Initial website audit and prioritized action plan. - Updated, responsive website with improved UI/UX. - Implemented technical SEO improvements. - Keyword and competitor analysis with a Google ranking improvement strategy. - AEO and GEO implementation where appropriate. - Performance and accessibility testing. - A summary of completed work, baseline metrics, and recommendations for ongoing optimization. Proposal Requirements Please include: 1. What improvements would you recommend for our existing website? 2. What technologies and implementation approach would you use? 3. Share 2–3 relevant live projects and explain your role in each. 4. Have you improved Google rankings or organic traffic for previous clients? Please provide evidence where possible. 5. How would you approach SEO, AEO, and GEO for an AI technology brand? 6. What is your proposed project cost, timeline, and post-launch support arrangement? 7. What specific deliverables can you complete within our budget? We are looking for someone who combines strong design skills, technical expertise, and practical search optimization experience. We value transparent reporting, measurable improvements, and sustainable SEO practices over unrealistic ranking promises. Please review our existing website before submitting your proposal. Bids must remain under ₹50,000 INR, with the scope and deliverables clearly defined. Website: https://aimstudio.co.in/

opportunities.title: Central IA para Gestión de Requerimientos
opportunities.description: Somos una empresa pequeña de seguridad privada que está iniciando y tenemos un WhatsApp Business utilizado por nuestra Central de Monitoreo. Buscamos un desarrollador que nos ayude a implementar una automatización sencilla y económica, utilizando IA/bots y WhatsApp Business, sin necesidad de desarrollar un sistema complejo. Lo que necesitamos 1. Reacciones automáticas en grupos Nuestro WhatsApp de Central pertenece a grupos donde los guardias realizan reportes. Queremos que automáticamente: • Seleccione aleatoriamente algunos reportes. • Reaccione con me gusta directamente al mensaje. • Aproximadamente 10 reacciones al día: 5 durante el día y 5 durante la noche. • Sin enviar mensajes adicionales. Importante: El desarrollador deberá confirmar si esto es técnicamente posible con la solución que propone. 2. Atención automática a clientes Cuando un cliente escriba directamente a nuestro WhatsApp, queremos una atención mediante IA que sea natural, profesional y breve. La IA deberá identificar principalmente: * Operativo: consultas y requerimientos normales que pueda atender la Central. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. * Importante: quejas, fallas, ausencias, incumplimientos o incidentes. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. * Crítico: robo, intrusión, agresión, incendio o emergencias. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. 3. Solicitudes fuera del alcance Si el cliente solicita algo que la Central no puede realizar, por ejemplo una supervisión presencial, reemplazo de guardia, envío de supervisor u otra actividad no contemplada, la IA deberá simplemente indicar: “Hemos recibido su requerimiento. Lo informaremos al Jefe de Operaciones para su gestión y atención. Se dará solución al requerimiento lo antes posible.” No deberá prometer acciones que GESAC no haya confirmado. 4. Atención natural Las respuestas no deben ser instantáneas. Queremos un pequeño tiempo de espera, aproximadamente 30 segundos o más, para que la conversación sea natural. También necesitamos poder tomar manualmente una conversación cuando sea necesario. Buscamos una solución económica Somos una empresa de seguridad pequeña y estamos iniciando, por lo que tenemos un presupuesto limitado. No buscamos desarrollar una plataforma grande ni un sistema complejo. Queremos comenzar con una solución sencilla, funcional y económica, utilizando herramientas/API existentes siempre que sea posible. El postulante deberá indicarnos: • Qué tecnología propone. • Si puede realizar las reacciones me gusta en grupos. • Costo del desarrollo. • Costos mensuales aproximados de WhatsApp/IA u otras herramientas. • Tiempo estimado. Se valorarán especialmente propuestas económicas, simples y fáciles de mantener.

opportunities.title: Consumer Product 3D CAD Model
opportunities.description: I need a production-ready 3D CAD drawing of a small consumer product so I can run an accurate FDM test print. You will work from the photos and physical sample I already have; I can provide reference dimensions as soon as we start. Your task is to translate those references into a clean, watertight model, optimise any thin walls or overhangs for printing, and keep every critical feature faithful to the sample. Solid-model software such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or comparable industry tools is fine—use whichever you prefer as long as it can export reliably. Deliverables • Native editable file • STEP and STL exports ready for slicing The job is finished when the files slice without errors and the printed dimensions stay within ±0.2 mm of the supplied measurements.

opportunities.title: Fotografías de Vallas Digitales
opportunities.description: El encargo consiste en capturar imágenes nítidas y de alta resolución de 14 vallas digitales ubicadas en El Salvador. Las tomas deben mostrar claramente el contenido que se proyecta, la estructura completa de la valla y su entorno inmediato para que se aprecie la escala y el contexto. El trabajo es urgente y necesito contar con el material final lo antes posible. Entregables mínimos • Serie completa de fotografías en formato JPG (alta resolución). • Al menos tres ángulos por valla: plano general, plano medio y un acercamiento donde el mensaje digital se lea con total claridad. • Breve ficha por archivo con la localización (coordenadas o dirección), fecha y hora de la toma. Aceptación: las imágenes deben estar bien expuestas, libres de desenfoques, sin reflejos que oculten el contenido mostrado en la pantalla y con suficiente iluminación para uso comercial. Adjunta una propuesta detallada que incluya tu metodología, tiempos y cualquier recurso extra que consideres necesario para asegurar la cobertura completa dentro del plazo urgente indicado.

opportunities.title: 15-Minute 3D Kids Animations
opportunities.description: I have a set of children’s stories that need to be brought to life as vibrant, 15-minute 3D animated videos. Each video should feel like a mini-episode—fun, engaging, and age-appropriate for young children—so think bright colours, expressive characters, and simple visual humour that keeps their attention from start to finish. You’ll receive the scripts, character briefs, and any reference artwork I already have. From there, I’ll rely on your full 3D pipeline skills: modelling, rigging, animation, lighting, rendering, and final compositing, along with a polished soundtrack (music, basic SFX, and voice-over integration). Story pacing is important; the narrative should flow smoothly for a 15-minute runtime without dragging or feeling rushed. Deliverables • One complete 15-minute 3D animated video (1080p or higher, H.264) • All project files (source rigs, textures, scene files) neatly organised so I can archive or update later • A version with and without embedded audio Acceptance criteria • Visual style matches the provided references and remains consistent throughout the episode • Animation is fluid and expressive, suitable for a children’s audience • Final export is free of rendering glitches, synced correctly with audio, and ready for immediate release on streaming platforms If this sounds like a creative challenge you’d enjoy, let’s discuss timelines and milestones so we can start production right away.

opportunities.title: Gestor de ventas por WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Manejo un negocio de productos físicos y la mayoría de mis clientes escriben por WhatsApp. Necesito a alguien que se convierta en mi “mano derecha” en el chat para que la conversación fluya y termine en una compra cerrada. Lo que requiero que hagas: • Contestar dudas sobre productos con información clara y amable. • Tomar pedidos y datos de envío con exactitud, usando la plantilla que compartiré. • Convencer al cliente para que compre aplicando técnicas de venta persuasivas pero respetuosas. Detalles operativos: – El horario es flexible, pero espero respuestas ágiles (idealmente en menos de 10 minutos cuando haya mensajes nuevos). – Te entregaré catálogo, precios, políticas y ejemplos de respuestas para que tengas todo a mano. – Registra cada conversación y venta en una hoja de cálculo de seguimiento; esto incluye nombre del cliente, producto, monto y dirección de envío. – Si surge alguna pregunta que no puedas resolver, me la escalas de inmediato. Busco una persona con ortografía impecable, buena conexión a internet y gusto por el trato al cliente. Si ya tienes experiencia cerrando ventas por WhatsApp, cuéntame resultados concretos; de lo contrario, muéstrame cómo abordarías una consulta típica. Quiero crear una relación a largo plazo que genere ingresos para ambos y ayude a mi familia a seguir creciendo con este negocio.

opportunities.title: Endless 3D Traffic Racer
opportunities.description: I’m building a lightweight highway-runner where the player must guide one car through 3 km of oncoming traffic without a single collision. The look I’m after is a clean, low-poly cartoon aesthetic—think bright colours, simple shapes, and no heavy shaders—so performance stays smooth on most Android devices. Core gameplay • The player car slides left or right using either phone tilt or a quick swipe; both control schemes must be active and switchable from a pause menu. • Traffic consists of cars, buses, and lorries spawning in both directions with steadily increasing speed. • A distance meter (0 km → 3 km) sits top-centre. Contact with any vehicle ends the run with a Game Over screen; reaching 3 km triggers a Win screen. • Overall speed ramps up gradually to keep tension high yet fair. Tech & deliverables • Unity (any recent LTS) targeting Android; deliver an installable APK plus the full, well-organised source project. • All 3-D assets may be free or custom, but must match the low-poly cartoon style and be licence-cleared for commercial use. • Scripted spawner, simple UI panels (start, pause, game over, win), safe-zone lane logic, and basic sound hooks for engine, crash, and victory stingers. • Build should hold 60 fps on mid-range devices (e.g., Snapdragon 732G) and support both portrait and landscape if practical, portrait minimum. • Clear comments in code and a short README explaining scene setup and how to tweak traffic density or speed curve. Please start your proposal with the phrase “CAR GAME 3KM” so I know you’ve read the details. Looking forward to seeing how you’ll bring this quick-fire racer to life.

opportunities.title: Full Wedding Video Editor
opportunities.description: I have the complete raw footage from my wedding and need it shaped into a single, full-length film that feels simple and natural from start to finish. The project covers the entire day—ceremony, speeches, and key reception moments—edited together so it plays smoothly in chronological order without flashy effects or heavy filters. What I’m after • Clean cuts that keep the emotional flow intact • Light colour correction and basic audio balancing to ensure voices are clear • Natural transitions; nothing overly cinematic or slow-motion heavy • Discreet lower-third title cards for each major segment (e.g., Ceremony, Speeches, First Dance) • Final master in 1080p (H.264/MP4) plus an export-ready file for YouTube/Vimeo I’ll provide all video and audio files via cloud link and notes on any must-include shots. Once you send back a first draft, I’ll give time-coded feedback for tweaks. On approval, please deliver the final render along with the editable project file (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred). If you work efficiently, keep the style true to the footage, and can turn this around within two weeks, we’ll be a perfect match.

opportunities.title: Estrategia Integral de Marketing Digital y Soporte para Mezcal Arte...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o equipo con experiencia en marketing digital y atención al cliente para impulsar la marca de mezcal artesanal "La Patrona". El objetivo principal es generar un impacto significativo en el mercado y aumentar la visibilidad del producto, así como gestionar las interacciones con posibles clientes. Las responsabilidades incluyen: - Desarrollar e implementar una estrategia de marketing digital robusta para el mezcal "La Patrona", buscando un crecimiento acelerado en el reconocimiento de marca. - Crear contenido atractivo y campañas publicitarias que resalten la calidad y el carácter artesanal del producto. - Gestionar la comunicación y responder a las preguntas de posibles clientes a través de los canales digitales, proporcionando información clara y persuasiva. - Asegurar que todas las actividades de promoción y comunicación cumplan estrictamente con las regulaciones para la venta y publicidad de bebidas alcohólicas. Es fundamental incluir advertencias como "No apto para menores de edad" y "El abuso del consumo es dañino para la salud" en todo material promocional. El candidato ideal debe tener un profundo conocimiento de las normativas de publicidad de alcohol, creatividad para el marketing de bebidas espirituosas y excelentes habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con el público. Se valorará la proactividad y la capacidad de generar ideas innovadoras para posicionar el mezcal "La Patrona" en el mercado. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Marca mediana, nivel de interacción medio

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Video Module for Design Course -- 2
opportunities.description: Title: AutoCAD Instructor: Record a Video Module for an Interior Design Course (From Scratch) Job Description: We are looking for an experienced AutoCAD instructor or an interior designer with top-tier drafting skills to record a comprehensive, beginner-friendly video learning module. The module will be integrated into our "Interior Design from Scratch" online course. During the course, our students receive a real property project brief and an empty floor plan. The goal of your module is to teach them AutoCAD fundamentals completely from scratch and guide them through creating their own individual floor plan based on the provided brief. Key Responsibilities: • Plan and record a step-by-step video module teaching AutoCAD to absolute beginners. • Guide students through the software interface, essential tools, and drafting workflows. • Use a real-world empty floor plan to demonstrate how to build an interior layout from a project brief. Approximate outline of what needs to be recorded: Module 1. Getting Started with AutoCAD • How to Successfully Complete the Module • Installing AutoCAD • Lesson 1. Downloading and Installing AutoCAD. How to install AutoCAD on your computer or laptop. Essential AutoCAD library for getting started. • Lesson 2. Getting Started and Essential Tools. How AutoCAD works. Understanding the interface and the essential tools you need to get started. • Lesson 3. Creating Geometric Shapes: Dimensions, Layers, and Properties Working with shapes, adding dimensions, using layers, and saving drawings. • Lesson 4. Creating a Technical Detail: Hatching and Projections. Creating a technical detail drawing and side view. Different types of hatching and how they are used. • Lesson 5. Creating a Measured Floor Plan. Applying your AutoCAD skills in practice. Transferring on-site measurements into AutoCAD and creating a measured floor plan. • Lesson 6. Room Schedule and Area Calculations. Creating a room schedule based on the measured floor plan. Room numbering and area calculations. • Lesson 7. Blocks and Groups. Creating blocks, understanding their properties and functionality, and working with furniture blocks. Module 2. Space Planning • Lesson 1. Introduction to Space Planning. Core principles of space planning. Ergonomics. Common technical mistakes. Understanding what clients typically expect from a space plan. • Lesson 2. Working with Small Spaces • Lesson 3. Space Planning in AutoCAD. Creating a space plan in AutoCAD. Drawing walls, placing furniture, adding furniture dimensions, and developing wall and partition plans. Requirements: • Good English communication skills with clear, articulate pronunciation. • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible terms for beginners. Even if you haven't recorded similar lessons before, but you are confident you can handle it, please apply! • Expertise in AutoCAD applied specifically to interior design/architecture. Project Scope & Timeline: Please submit your proposals stating your estimated timeline and your fixed price for the complete course structure outlined above. How to Apply: • Please attach a couple of your drawings and confirm your readiness to record a 5-minute sample video after agreeing on the terms, so we can hear how you explain. • In your proposal, please state your approximate price for recording the entire volume of these modules.

opportunities.description: I have a set of Microsoft Word files that must be turned into PDFs without a single shift in layout, font, margin, or spacing. Please use whatever combination of Word’s own exporter, Adobe Acrobat, or other reliable PDF tools you trust, as long as the final files look pixel-perfect beside the source documents. opportunities.title: Luxury Clinic Reception Design
opportunities.description: I’m opening a new aesthetic clinic and would like to start with a truly memorable reception and waiting area. The look I’m aiming for is unmistakably luxury and elegant, yet calm, using a palette of beige, soft neutrals and generous touches of marble. Here’s what I need from you: • A refined floor-plan that makes check-in effortless and guides clients smoothly toward treatment rooms. • Mood board and material specifications that capture the beige-marble scheme without drifting into cold minimalism. • High-quality 3D visualisations (or photorealistic renders) so I can see lighting, textures and furniture in context. • A concise finishes schedule noting paints, stone, fixtures, lighting and suggested furniture brands. All drawings should be delivered in editable format (CAD or SketchUp/Revit) along with print-ready PDFs. 3D imagery can be in Lumion/Enscape/V-Ray—whatever you prefer, as long as the final files are high resolution. Once the reception concept is approved I plan to roll the same language through the rest of the clinic, so a cohesive design approach is important. Please share relevant portfolio pieces that showcase luxury, elegance and thoughtful space planning.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40781695, publicado hace 14 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 1,500 - 12,500.

opportunities.title: Nepal 2D & 3D Animation
opportunities.description: I have a creative concept that calls for a series of high-quality 2D and 3D animations centred solely on Nepal. The content is intentionally different from standard tourism spots, classroom explainers, or straight-forward product ads; it will tell its own story and reach a niche audience outside the usual categories. Because of this “other” focus, the visuals must feel fresh while still remaining unmistakably Nepali in tone and detail. Here is the outline of what I need: • A complete production pipeline—from initial storyboard through final render—delivered in Full-HD (1080p) or higher. • Mixed 2D and 3D sequences that flow together seamlessly, including any modelling, rigging, texturing, compositing, and motion graphics needed. • Authentic references: accurate colours, motifs, and environmental cues so that every frame immediately evokes Nepal even though the subject matter is not limited to landmarks, festivals, or wildlife. • Source files (Maya/Blender/Cinema 4D, After Effects, Illustrator, etc.) alongside the final mastered video so I can create future versions. • Two rounds of revisions to fine-tune pacing, lighting, and colour grade. Acceptance criteria 1. Storyboard approved before full production begins. 2. Final video matches agreed timing and resolution, without frame-drops or artefacts. 3. All assets supplied in organised project folders with clear naming conventions. If you have a show-reel that blends 2D and 3D work—especially pieces where you developed a culturally specific look—that will help me gauge fit quickly. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right partner.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40781659, publicado hace 15 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador de Seguros por Comisión
opportunities.description: Teleoperador/a de seguros con experiencia. Remoto, horario de España, solo comisión. Agencia de seguros en Toledo (España) busca una persona con experiencia demostrable en venta telefónica de seguros para llamar a nuestra cartera de clientes y vender cuatro ramos: hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y salud. Renovaciones, seguimiento de presupuestos y venta cruzada a clientes que ya nos conocen. Sin captación en frío a particulares. Condiciones: unas 3 horas al día en horario comercial de España (mañanas o tardes a convenir), colaboración mercantil por objetivos. Sin fijo: cobras el 50 % de la comisión que la aseguradora paga a la agencia por cada póliza nueva que consigas, durante el primer año de la póliza, al cobro del primer recibo. La agencia cobra el 15 % de la prima en hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y el 10 % en salud: tu parte es el 7,5 % y el 5 % de cada prima. Además, 100 EUR de bono por cada 5 pólizas del mismo ramo emitidas en el mismo mes. Prueba de 2 semanas y continuidad si funciona. Línea telefónica, hoja de control y formación de producto a cargo de la agencia. Requisitos: mínimo 1 año de experiencia en televenta de seguros o productos financieros (se verifica); español claro; residencia en España, Argentina o Uruguay; ordenador, auriculares y conexión estable; firma de acuerdo de confidencialidad y protección de datos antes de acceder a ningún dato. En tu propuesta indica: experiencia concreta en seguros (empresa, producto, resultados), franja horaria disponible en hora de Madrid y si aceptas una llamada de prueba de 10 minutos con un guion real.

opportunities.title: Atención WhatsApp para Clientes
opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo diario para responder consultas de clientes que llegan por WhatsApp acerca de nuestros productos y servicios. El foco principal es aclarar dudas y brindar, en cada mensaje, información clara de precios y disponibilidad. Cómo trabajaremos: • Te compartiré nuestro catálogo/lista de precios actualizada; ahí encontrarás todo lo necesario para responder con precisión. • Mantendrás un tono cordial, profesional y coherente con la imagen de la marca. • Registrarás preguntas frecuentes o inquietudes recurrentes para que podamos mejorar la información del catálogo. • Avisarás de inmediato si algún precio o stock no coincide con lo que el cliente está solicitando. Busco a alguien organizado, con excelente redacción en español y experiencia previa en atención al cliente por mensajería instantánea (WhatsApp Business, Zendesk o herramientas similares). Si te interesa, coméntame tu experiencia y disponibilidad horaria.

opportunities.title: Mapa Zone War Metro Tobalaba
opportunities.description: Quiero publicar un mapa de Zone Wars para 16 jugadores en UEFN / Fortnite Creative 2.0 ambientado en el entorno del Metro Tobalaba. El punto neurálgico será una cafetería Marley Coffee junto a la entrada del metro; alrededor se alzarán modelos inspirados en el Costanera Center y el Parque Titanium para dar referencia visual y verticalidad al combate. Además de la arquitectura, necesito integrar la marca “Marley RTD” dentro de la jugabilidad: • Dispensadores y visicoolers Marley calibrados a 4 °C que, al interactuar, entreguen latas RTD (Cappuccino, Caramel o Vainilla Latte). • Cada lata funcionará como un consumible rápido tipo Slurp Juice o Pepper: +25 de escudo y aumento temporal de velocidad/estamina con un destello ámbar que represente el “despabile” para rotaciones dentro de la tormenta. Requisitos técnicos clave: • Modo principal: Zone Wars competitivo por rondas. • Desarrollo íntegro en UEFN con lógica de tormenta, respawns y conteo de victorias. • Optimización para 16 jugadores simultáneos y fluidez en consolas. • Texturas y assets fieles a Santiago, manteniendo performance dentro de los límites de memoria. • Publicación y testing interno conmigo antes de enviar a Epic para la aprobación final. Entrego referencias fotográficas y lineamientos de marca; tú te ocupas de modelado, scripting (Verse), iluminación y balance de power-ups. Espero un mapa completamente funcional, listo para subir a la isla pública, más un paquete editable (.uasset) por si en el futuro hay que agregar campañas o skins de temporada. Tomando como base la ciudad de tilted towers.

Además de la arquitectura, necesito integrar la marca “Marley RTD” dentro de la jugabilidad: • Dispensadores y visicoolers Marley calibrados a 4 °C que, al interactuar, entreguen latas RTD (Cappuccino, Caramel o Vainilla Latte). • Cada lata funcionará como un consumible rápido tipo Slurp Juice o Pepper: +25 de escudo y aumento temporal de velocidad/estamina con un destello ámbar que represente el “despabile” para rotaciones dentro de la tormenta. Requisitos técnicos clave: • Modo principal: Zone Wars competitivo por rondas. • Desarrollo íntegro en UEFN con lógica de tormenta, respawns y conteo de victorias. • Optimización para 16 jugadores simultáneos y fluidez en consolas. • Texturas y assets fieles a Santiago, manteniendo performance dentro de los límites de memoria. • Publicación y testing interno conmigo antes de enviar a Epic para la aprobación final. Entrego referencias fotográficas y lineamientos de marca; tú te ocupas de modelado, scripting (Verse), iluminación y balance de power-ups. Espero un mapa completamente funcional, listo para subir a la isla pública, más un paquete editable (.uasset) por si en el futuro hay que agregar campañas o skins de temporada. Tomando como base la ciudad de tilted towers."

opportunities.title: Comercial cierre servicios arboricultura
opportunities.description: Soy Enric, arborista profesional autónomo especializado en talas y podas complejas, con base en Palafrugell, Baix Empordà. Busco un perfil comercial freelance que capte y cierre proyectos grandes con empresas constructoras, inmobiliarias y gestores de fincas. Qué espero de tu labor: Prospección y contactos cualificados en el sector construcción y gestión de fincas. Negociación y cierre de acuerdos centrados en talas y desmontajes técnicos de arbolado, también previos a obras, y podas de grandes conjuntos de arbolado, como comunidades con decenas de pinos. Coordinación conmigo: el presupuesto técnico lo elaboro y emito yo. La visita para presupuestar es gratuita; los asesoramientos y cualquier otro servicio se cobran. Comisión: Mínimo del 10 % sobre el beneficio bruto de cada trabajo, a negociar según el proyecto. Lo que valoro: Experiencia en cierre de ventas y en venta B2B. Contactos en construcción, promotoras o arquitectura (indica casos concretos). Si te interesa, cuéntame tu experiencia y cómo trabajarías.

opportunities.title: App gestión negocio con enlaces
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar una aplicación que me ayude a gestionar mi negocio y, sobre todo, que sirva como puerta de acceso a mis distintos sitios externos. La idea es que la app esté disponible tanto en Android como en iPhone y muestre, de forma ordenada, enlaces directos a mis páginas web y perfiles en redes sociales. Alcance principal • Pantalla inicial con el logo y un breve mensaje de bienvenida. • Menú o dashboard donde el usuario pueda tocar y abrir esos enlaces externos (páginas, redes). • Panel sencillo para que yo mismo pueda actualizar, añadir o quitar enlaces sin depender siempre del desarrollador. Entregables esperados – Código fuente completo (puede ser Flutter, React Native o similar). – Instaladores o builds listos para pruebas en Android y iOS. – Instrucciones claras de publicación en Google Play y App Store. Valoraré que la interfaz sea limpia, rápida y que siga las pautas básicas de usabilidad para móviles. Quedo atento a tus propuestas de tecnología, tiempo estimado y ejemplos de trabajos parecidos.

opportunities.description: Buscamos profesionales con experiencia en ventas telefónicas para unirse a nuestra campaña de venta de servicios, dirigida a empresas y autónomos en España. El trabajo es completamente remoto y ofrecemos todas las herramientas y el apoyo necesario para el éxito. Responsabilidades principales: - Contactar proactivamente con empresas de nuestra base de datos. - Establecer comunicación con los dueños o responsables de negocio. - Identificar las necesidades de los clientes y presentar propuestas de servicios adecuadas. - Resolver dudas, gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de contratación. - Registrar detalladamente las llamadas y realizar seguimientos en el CRM. opportunities.title: AI Smart Glasses: Stealth Camera & Integrated Display
opportunities.description: Custom AI Smart Glasses Prototype Inspired by Even Realities G2 – Concealed Camera and Integrated Display Project Description I am looking for an experienced hardware engineer, multidisciplinary engineering team or product development company to design, manufacture, assemble, test and deliver one complete, fully functional physical prototype of custom AI smart glasses to Spain. The design should be inspired by the elegant, minimalist appearance of the Even Realities G2, with a conventional, lightweight eyeglass frame rather than a bulky AR headset. The key difference is that my prototype must include an integrated camera that is completely invisible and unrecognisable from the outside, while retaining the discreet appearance of ordinary eyeglasses. I require the finished physical product, not just CAD files, 3D models, renders, designs or consulting services. The successful applicant must deliver the fully assembled and working prototype to Spain. 1. Design and Appearance * Design inspired by the Even Realities G2: minimalist, elegant and discreet. * Conventional eyeglass appearance, with a slim frame and temples. * Custom black frame, with proportions and styling similar to premium everyday glasses. * Lightweight and comfortable for daily use. * Electronics integrated into the frame and temples without bulky external modules. * No visible camera modules, protruding lenses or obvious technological features. * Custom mechanical design to accommodate the camera, optical display, battery and electronics. The finished glasses should look as close as possible to normal premium eyeglasses. 2. Completely Concealed Camera The main custom feature is a functional camera integrated into the frame, preferably in the bridge between the lenses. Requirements: * The camera lens must be completely invisible and unrecognisable from the outside. * No protruding camera or obvious camera opening. * Suitable field of view and image quality for AI vision applications. * Functional image capture and/or video streaming to a smartphone. * Compact camera module and suitable electrical connections. * Integration that preserves the frame’s conventional appearance. The developer must propose a technically feasible optical solution that allows the camera to capture images without compromising its field of view or image quality. A visible recording indicator LED must activate whenever recording is taking place. It should be discreetly integrated into the frame while remaining visible when illuminated. 3. Integrated Optical Display The display should provide functionality similar in concept to the Even Realities G2, allowing the wearer to read information privately through the lenses. Requirements: * Integrated near-eye optical display for displaying text. * Micro-OLED, waveguide or another suitable optical technology. * Necessary optics and display driver included. * Readable AI-generated responses without an external screen. * Minimal impact on the glasses’ appearance, weight and dimensions. * No bulky AR headset design. A display panel alone is insufficient. The developer must integrate the complete optical system required to display readable text. 4. Smartphone and AI Integration The smartphone should perform most of the AI processing to keep the glasses lightweight and energy-efficient. Required functionality: * Wireless connection between the glasses and a smartphone. * Transfer of images or video from the camera to the phone. * Image processing through an AI service. * Transmission of AI-generated responses back to the glasses. * Display of text responses through the integrated optical display. * Functional firmware and software demonstrating the complete workflow. A basic functional demonstration application is acceptable; a finished commercial application is not required. Please identify any required third-party APIs, subscriptions or recurring costs. 5. Electronics and Manufacturing The finished prototype must include: * Camera and optical components. * Integrated display and driver. * Microcontroller and control electronics. * Wireless connectivity. * Battery, charging system and power management. * PCBs, flexible cables and connectors. * Recording indicator LED. * Firmware and required software. * Electrical, thermal and functional testing. The developer must handle mechanical engineering, CAD modelling, frame manufacturing, electronic integration, assembly and testing. 6. Mandatory Deliverables The project will only be considered complete when I receive: 1. One fully assembled and functional pair of physical smart glasses. 2. A discreet frame inspired by the Even Realities G2. 3. A working camera that is invisible and unrecognisable from the outside. 4. A functional optical display capable of showing readable text. 5. Wireless connectivity with a smartphone. 6. A demonstrated camera-to-AI-to-display workflow. 7. A working recording indicator. 8. Battery, charger and necessary accessories. 9. Tested firmware and software. 10. A video demonstrating the actual prototype working before shipment. 11. Editable CAD files and mechanical design files. 12. Electronic schematics and bill of materials. 13. Firmware, source code and agreed technical documentation. 14. Shipment of the finished prototype to Spain with tracking information. CAD files, renders or simulations alone are not acceptable as the final deliverable. 7. Required Experience Applicants should have demonstrable experience in: * Smart glasses and wearable electronics. * AR displays, micro-OLED and near-eye optics. * Miniature camera integration. * Embedded electronics and firmware. * Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and smartphone connectivity. * Mechanical engineering and CAD. * 3D printing and functional hardware prototyping. * Electronic assembly, testing and product integration. Experience delivering complete physical wearable devices is strongly preferred. 8. Questions for Applicants Please answer the following questions in your proposal: 1. Have you previously designed, built and delivered smart glasses or similar wearable devices? 2. Can you provide photographs or videos of real hardware you have developed? 3. Can you manage the entire project and deliver the finished prototype to Spain? 4. How would you integrate a camera into the bridge while keeping it invisible from the outside? 5. What optical display technology would you recommend for a design similar to the Even Realities G2? 6. How would you minimise weight and maintain a conventional appearance? 7. What is your total estimated price, including engineering, components, manufacturing, assembly, testing and shipping? 8. What is the expected development and delivery timeline? 9. Will you provide the CAD files, source code and technical documentation? 10. Can you work with milestone-based payments and demonstrate the working prototype before shipment? 9. Budget and Payment Terms Please provide an itemised quotation covering engineering, design, optical components, camera, electronics, frame manufacturing, software, assembly, testing and shipping to Spain. I am open to proposals from experienced freelancers, engineering teams and specialist hardware development companies. Milestone-based payments linked to verifiable deliverables are preferred. Any additional costs or subcontracting must be agreed in advance. The agreement must specify the delivery of the custom CAD files, electronic designs, firmware and source code developed for the project. Third-party components, licences and recurring costs must be disclosed. Final Objective To receive one complete, fully assembled, tested and operational pair of custom AI smart glasses delivered to my address in Spain. The design must be inspired by the Even Realities G2, with a conventional and discreet appearance, a camera completely invisible from the outside, an integrated optical display for reading AI responses, smartphone-based AI processing and delivery of the finished physical prototype. I am not looking for a designer who only provides drawings or models. I need a professional or team capable of developing, manufacturing and delivering the actual working product.

A visible recording indicator LED must activate whenever recording is taking place. It should be discreetly integrated into the frame while remaining visible when illuminated. 3. Integrated Optical Display The display should provide functionality similar in concept to the Even Realities G2, allowing the wearer to read information privately through the lenses. Requirements: * Integrated near-eye optical display for displaying text. * Micro-OLED, waveguide or another suitable optical technology. * Necessary optics and display driver included. * Readable AI-generated responses without an external screen. * Minimal impact on the glasses’ appearance, weight and dimensions. * No bulky AR headset design. A display panel alone is insufficient. The developer must integrate the complete optical system required to display readable text. 4. Smartphone and AI Integration The smartphone should perform most of the AI processing to keep the glasses lightweight and energy-efficient. Required functionality: * Wireless connection between the glasses and a smartphone. * Transfer of images or video from the camera to the phone. * Image processing through an AI service. * Transmission of AI-generated responses back to the glasses. * Display of text responses through the integrated optical display. * Functional firmware and software demonstrating the complete workflow. A basic functional demonstration application is acceptable; a finished commercial application is not required. Please identify any required third-party APIs, subscriptions or recurring costs. 5. Electronics and Manufacturing The finished prototype must include: * Camera and optical components. * Integrated display and driver. * Microcontroller and control electronics. * Wireless connectivity. * Battery, charging system and power management. * PCBs, flexible cables and connectors. * Recording indicator LED. * Firmware and required software. * Electrical, thermal and functional testing. The developer must handle mechanical engineering, CAD modelling, frame manufacturing, electronic integration, assembly and testing. 6. Mandatory Deliverables The project will only be considered complete when I receive: 1. One fully assembled and functional pair of physical smart glasses. 2. A discreet frame inspired by the Even Realities G2. 3. A working camera that is invisible and unrecognisable from the outside. 4. A functional optical display capable of showing readable text. 5. Wireless connectivity with a smartphone. 6. A demonstrated camera-to-AI-to-display workflow. 7. A working recording indicator. 8. Battery, charger and necessary accessories. 9. Tested firmware and software. 10. A video demonstrating the actual prototype working before shipment. 11. Editable CAD files and mechanical design files. 12. Electronic schematics and bill of materials. 13. Firmware, source code and agreed technical documentation. 14. Shipment of the finished prototype to Spain with tracking information. CAD files, renders or simulations alone are not acceptable as the final deliverable. 7. Required Experience Applicants should have demonstrable experience in: * Smart glasses and wearable electronics. * AR displays, micro-OLED and near-eye optics. * Miniature camera integration. * Embedded electronics and firmware. * Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and smartphone connectivity. * Mechanical engineering and CAD. * 3D printing and functional hardware prototyping. * Electronic assembly, testing and product integration. Experience delivering complete physical wearable devices is strongly preferred. 8. Questions for Applicants Please answer the following questions in your proposal: 1. Have you previously designed, built and delivered smart glasses or similar wearable devices? 2. Can you provide photographs or videos of real hardware you have developed? 3. Can you manage the entire project and deliver the finished prototype to Spain? 4. How would you integrate a camera into the bridge while keeping it invisible from the outside? 5. What optical display technology would you recommend for a design similar to the Even Realities G2? 6. How would you minimise weight and maintain a conventional appearance? 7. What is your total estimated price, including engineering, components, manufacturing, assembly, testing and shipping? 8. What is the expected development and delivery timeline? 9. Will you provide the CAD files, source code and technical documentation? 10. Can you work with milestone-based payments and demonstrate the working prototype before shipment? 9. Budget and Payment Terms Please provide an itemised quotation covering engineering, design, optical components, camera, electronics, frame manufacturing, software, assembly, testing and shipping to Spain. I am open to proposals from experienced freelancers, engineering teams and specialist hardware development companies. Milestone-based payments linked to verifiable deliverables are preferred. Any additional costs or subcontracting must be agreed in advance. The agreement must specify the delivery of the custom CAD files, electronic designs, firmware and source code developed for the project. Third-party components, licences and recurring costs must be disclosed. Final Objective To receive one complete, fully assembled, tested and operational pair of custom AI smart glasses delivered to my address in Spain. The design must be inspired by the Even Realities G2, with a conventional and discreet appearance, a camera completely invisible from the outside, an integrated optical display for reading AI responses, smartphone-based AI processing and delivery of the finished physical prototype. I am not looking for a designer who only provides drawings or models. I need a professional or team capable of developing, manufacturing and delivering the actual working product."

opportunities.title: Diseño Banco Pruebas Hidráulicas -- 2
opportunities.description: Necesito un diseño integral de un banco de pruebas para bombas hidráulicas que opere a alta presión. El sistema debe servir para verificar el desempeño de bombas de desplazamiento positivo, centrífugas y de engranajes, o cualquier otra variante que requiera mi línea de producción. Requisitos clave • Rango de trabajo: alta presión con capacidad de ajuste fino. • Funciones obligatorias: monitoreo de caudal en tiempo real y un módulo de calibración automática para agilizar los ensayos. • Instrumentación: sensores de presión y caudal, válvulas de seguridad, y una interfaz de control que permita registrar datos y generar reportes. • Integración posible con software de adquisición (por ejemplo LabVIEW o similar) y control mediante PLC. Entregables esperados - Planos mecánicos y esquemas hidráulicos listos para fabricación (formatos SolidWorks/AutoCAD o equivalente). - Diagrama eléctrico y lista de materiales con especificaciones de cada componente. - Lógica de control detallada, incluyendo rutinas de calibración y umbrales de alarma. - Manual de montaje, puesta en marcha y mantenimiento preventivo. Valoraré experiencia previa diseñando bancos de pruebas de alta presión, dominio de normativas de seguridad hidráulica y capacidad para acompañarme en ajustes posteriores si fuera necesario.
